title: Design System: Noel Alex — Modded Client

stat.purpose: Measured headline numbers on guidebook number pages.

headline.purpose: Screen titles and guidebook section heads.

shadows.name: bevel-raised
shadows.purpose: Buttons at rest; swap for pressed.

shadows.name: book-lift
shadows.purpose: The guidebook floating over the world; the only soft shadow.

shadows.name: text-client
shadows.purpose: Text shadow on all GUI text over dark ground.

motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: world-filter

components.name: Stone Button
components.description: Every menu action, in full, half, icon and auto widths.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 400px; max-width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid #000; background: #6f6f6f; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 #a9a9a9, inset -2px -4px 0 #3a3a3a; color: #e0e0e0; font: 16px/1.1 Monocraft, ui-monospace, monospace; text-shadow: 0.125em 0.125em 0 #3f3f3f; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { background: #7d86b8; color: #ffff55; border-color: #fff; outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 #3a3a3a, inset -2px -2px 0 #a9a9a9; } .ds-btn:disabled { background: #2c2c2c; color: #8a8a8a; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Black client text field, as in the Mods search.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; background: #000; border: 2px solid #a0a0a0; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #fff; } .ds-input input { flex: 1; background: none; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #e0e0e0; caret-color: #fff; font: 16px Monocraft, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #8a8a8a; }

components.name: Hotbar
components.description: Nine build slots; the selected one wears the white frame.
components.css: .ds-hotbar { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; background: #00000080; border: 2px solid #1a1a1a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8a8a8a; } .ds-hot { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: none; border: 0; color: #fff; font: 11px Monocraft, monospace; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #00000040; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hot.is-on { outline: 4px solid #fff; outline-offset: -2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-hot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffff55; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Item Tooltip
components.description: Purple-edged tooltip for items, builds and advancements.
components.css: .ds-tip { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: max-content; max-width: 280px; padding: 6px 8px; background: #100010f2; border: 2px solid transparent; border-image: linear-gradient(#5000ff, #28007f) 1; outline: 2px solid #100010f2; color: #fff; font: 14px/1.35 Monocraft, monospace; text-shadow: 0.125em 0.125em 0 #3f3f3f; } .ds-tip span { color: #a8a8a8; }

components.name: Inventory Slot
components.description: Sunken 36px slot inside a grey container panel.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: inline-flex; padding: 14px; background: #c6c6c6; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 0 #fff, inset -4px -4px 0 #555; } .ds-slot { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; background: #8b8b8b; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 #373737, inset -2px -2px 0 #fff; position: relative; } .ds-slot:hover::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px; background: #ffffff80; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffff55; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Guidebook Page
components.description: Cream page with oxblood section head and measured stats.

By the numbers

components.css: .ds-page { width: 360px; padding: 34px 38px; background: #f3ead3; color: #2b1d12; border: 14px solid #6b3a1e; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #c89b3c; font: 16px/1.7 Monocraft, monospace; } .ds-page h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 18px; color: #8c2b16; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 2px solid #c9b98f; } .ds-page strong { display: block; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.1; color: #8c2b16; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is not a website styled like Minecraft; it is a Minecraft client with a modpack installed. The title screen sits over a live, slowly orbiting voxel island; menus are the client's own menus; and the project writeups are Patchouli-style guidebooks with cream pages and a leather cover. Density follows the client: compact, pixel-exact GUI chrome with generous measure on reading surfaces. The world carries the color; the GUI stays grey and lets it through.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, Monocraft, for every role, rendered with the client's hard one-unit text shadow.
GUI depth is drawn with inset pixel bevels, never soft drop shadows.
The 3D world is always present behind the UI and changes treatment per screen.
Textures are painted in code from the world's own block tiles.
Every number on a page is a measured result; illustrations say they are illustrations.

rules.name: The Client Palette Rule
rules.body: GUI text uses Minecraft's formatting colors and nothing else. New accents belong to the world or the book, never to chrome.

rules.name: The Book Keeps Its Ink Rule
rules.body: Oxblood and cream live only inside guidebooks.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Monocraft carries every role. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and color.

rules.name: The Shadow Is The Font Rule
rules.body: GUI text on dark ground carries the client's hard text shadow; text on paper or light panels carries none.

rules.name: The Bevel Not Blur Rule
rules.body: Chrome never gets a soft drop shadow. A raised GUI element is raised by its bevel.

dos: Do take every new texture from the world's own painted tiles (tileCanvas) so GUI and world share one material.
Do keep numbers paired with their limits, and label illustrative demos as illustrations.
Do give every 3D interaction a DOM route (hotbar, Mods list, guidebook routes like /world/helix).
Do drive reduced motion from html[data-motion], so animations still end and fire their end events.
Do keep Monocraft subset to the characters the copy uses, and re-run the subset when copy adds a new glyph.
donts: Don't add soft drop shadows, glass or gradients to GUI chrome; use the bevels.
Don't use Mojang's textures, logo or sounds; everything is painted or synthesized in code.
Don't describe the methods behind Stretchy, Arachne + PhishGuard or PolySafe; outcomes and numbers only.
Don't put kicker labels above headings or helper text under controls; if a screen needs it, fix the screen.
